purpose: Teach: 割高/協業/行程/必勝/品切れ/伝言/月給/当座

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、輸入品が割高になっている
lines.en: Our imported products are getting too expensive.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. No preamble. Matter-of-fact tone. Steady gaze. The statement of a problem that needs addressing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先との協業案件を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward on a joint project with our trading partners.
lines.style: Formal, measured acknowledgment. Slight formality in the posture — respectful distance. Clear articulation. Each phrase lands with professional precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の開発行程を短縮しろ
lines.en: Cut the timeline for new product development.
lines.style: Firm command. Economical delivery — no softening. Weight on the verb. Expects compliance, not discussion. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業チームの必勝態勢を整えました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the sales team with a winning strategy.
lines.style: Confident briefing tone. A touch of pride — not boastful, just assured. Steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'winning' to signal readiness and competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人気商品が品切れになっているぞ
lines.en: Our popular items are sold out.
lines.style: Sharp, factual delivery. Slight edge — frustration held steady beneath the surface. Not accusatory, just stating the problem that exists.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先への伝言を確実にお伝えします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our trading partners receive the message clearly.
lines.style: Reassuring commitment. Slight lean forward — taking ownership. Calm certainty. Promises follow-through without overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、月給制度を見直せ
lines.en: We need to revise the company's salary structure.
lines.style: Declarative, unhurried. The tone of someone identifying a necessary change. Composed. Expects this to be understood as a strategic move, not a complaint.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当座の予算を確保いたしました
lines.en: Yes. I've secured the immediate budget needed.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Calm closure — problem acknowledged, solution in place. Slight exhale of completion. Professional finality.
